^Narrator: In contrast to the storm that swallowed you last night, calm waves now wash over the shore.
^Narrator: It seems like you've landed on a foreign island of some sort...
^Narrator: And nearby is a collapsed tree... and a tail?
^???: Don't think I can't see you!
^Narrator: You've never been outside of Dusk before, so you aren't sure what that is.
^Narrator: But if it isn't human, and it can speak... That means…
^???: Help me get out of here!
^Narrator: What do you do? Do you help the creature?
choiceNodont: ^Narrator: You take a step in the opposite direction.
^???: Hey! Are you seriously going to ignore someone in peril?! Get back here!
choiceYessaveAmelia: ^Narrator: You rush in, and with a surge of power that is unfamiliar to your limbs, you lift the tree off the creature.

^Amelia: (Great. Of course it's a human that saves me.)
^Amelia: Well, thanks and all. But this is where our meeting ends.

^Amelia: What? Just go back the way you came.

choiceitsalongstory: ^Amelia: Well, you can't just stay here. Your settlement’s probably looking for you.
